title: Vesper and the Letter
author: Petra Thackeray
blurb: Sebastian Ishikawa, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
